profile.dividendPolicy: No less than 40% of net profits based on the consolidated financial statements, after corporate income tax and legal reserves. Dividend payments will be considered with priority given to shareholder benefits, taking into account factors such as operating performance, financial position, future investment plans, loan repayments, and working capital. The dividend payment must not significantly affect the Company's normal operations, as deemed appropriate by the Board of Directors
